article.title: -(으)ㄴ/는 듯하다 formal
article.part: Conectores y modalidad avanzada — 고급 연결과 양태
article.chapter: Modalidad avanzada, expectativa y plausibilidad — 고급 양태·예상·개연성

claims.summary: The construction -(으)ㄴ/는 듯하다 expresses that something seems to be in a certain way based on indications, impression, or inference.

듯 is a dependent noun that conveys the idea of appearance or similarity. The preceding form changes according to the type of predicate and temporal relationship. The construction can refer to external facts or internal states or behaviors.
The article provides examples of -(으)ㄴ/는 듯하다 in action, such as '그는 무언가를 기다리는 듯했다' (He seemed to be waiting for something) and '회의가 이미 끝난 듯하다' (It seems like the meeting is already over).
